articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin
articles.snippet: Independent committees are assessing a potential tie-up, while strong SpaceX earnings lift shares ahead of Tesla’s results.

articles.title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
articles.snippet: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

articles.title: Strive closes $630M SATS IPO, leaves Bitcoin allocation unspecified
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin treasury company could acquire an estimated 7,372 BTC with its net proceeds, potentially surpassing Metaplanet’s holdings if it allocates the full amount.
